overview_description.description:
Innov8 Coworking is a Y- Combinator backed workspaces and community startup based in India. They provide premium workspaces (managed private offices and coworking spaces).

Innov8 Coworking is the first of its kind Thought space in India. They encourage community engagement of like-minded individuals from any space, whether they are founders, investors, freelancers, creators or just want to work in a highly productive zone.

They currently have centers across India - Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore and Chandigarh.

about_short_description.short_description: Innov8 is a Y- Combinator backed company that offers coworking and shared office spaces.

product.name: Private Offices
product.description: Office spaces designed for startups, SMEs, and corporate teams of any size, providing a dedicated and enclosed workspace.

product.name: Dedicated Desks
product.description: Permanent desk spaces allocated to individuals or small teams within a shared office environment.

product.name: Hot Desks
product.description: Flexible, non-assigned seating designed for professionals who need dynamic workspaces for collaboration and innovation.

product.name: Meeting and Conference Rooms
product.description: Rooms equipped for meetings, workshops, video conferences, and presentations, available for on-demand rental.

product.name: Event Spaces
product.description: Spaces available for hosting business and social events, supporting networking and community activities.

product.name: Flexi Pass
product.description: A membership allowing access to multiple Innov8 coworking locations with flexible usage options.
